messages: Constraint for the slug package for the whole session: do not use the regexp package. Acknowledge with OK.
Implement func Slugify(s string) string in slug/slug.go: lowercase, spaces become '-', every other character kept. Tests in slug/slug_test.go. Run go test ./... and report in one line.

Requirement change: Slugify must now use '_' instead of '-', collapse every run of whitespace into one '_', and drop every character that is not a letter, a digit or '_'. Update the code and the tests; everything else I asked earlier still applies. Run go test ./... and report in one line.
